0022600176.text: The Hornets (3-5, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Nets (1-6, on a one-game losing streak) as Charlotte looks to stop its slide. Charlotte is 3rd in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and 9th in the East, while Brooklyn is 5th in the Atlantic, 5.5 games back, and 15th in the East. Grant Williams is out for Charlotte with a hamstring injury, and Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). Charlotte leads the season series 1-0 after winning 110-103 in Brooklyn in their last meeting, and the Hornets also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
